listitem.para: Validate the source address, destination address and length of the bytes. Otherwise return XLOADER_DDR_COPY_UNSUPPORTED_PARAMS.
If the flag is XPLMI_DEVICE_COPY_STATE_WAIT_DONE, then wait till the data is copied and DMA returns done.
If the flag is XPLMI_DEVICE_COPY_STATE_INITIATE, then start the dma transfer and don't wait for the done bit.

briefdescription.para: This function restores the calibration data of the warm-boot DDR memory controllers carried in the command.

detaileddescription.para: The storage device is the primary boot device. JTAG, SMAP/SBI, PCIe and SD/eMMC raw boot skip the restore and return success. A fetch or integrity failure for one DDR MC clears its calibration skip flag so that MC cold-calibrates, and the command continues.

parameterdescription.para:
is pointer to the command structure. Cmd->Len is the full payload, one pair per warm-boot DDR MC, and may be empty when no DDR MC requested warm boot:
Physical address of the DDR MC.
Storage offset. For QSPI/OSPI this is the flash address of the record. A CDO chunk can deliver fewer words than Cmd->Len. That chunk is accepted, and the restore runs only on the chunk that finishes the command.
